depiction.primary_object: two curved arrows forming a clockwise circle
depiction.composition: centered checkmark enclosed by two circular sync arrows

readings.meaning: sync, update, or backup completed / verified

ambiguity: Can be confused with a plain task-completed checkmark or a generic refresh/reload icon at small sizes.
task_intents: verify cloud backup and file sync
replace recurring household filter or consumable

example_tasks.task: Make sure Obsidian vault syncs cleanly between laptop and phone
Renew car registration before the sticker expires next month
Verify automatic monthly transfer to the high-yield savings account
Install pending macOS security updates on the work MacBook
Check that Strava activities are syncing properly with Apple Health
Confirm all folders finished uploading to Backblaze before formatting drive
Renew professional liability insurance policy for the upcoming fiscal year

example_tasks_es: Renovar la suscripción anual de PlayStation Plus antes del viernes
Comprobar que la copia de seguridad de Google Fotos haya terminado
Actualizar el sistema operativo del iPad y las aplicaciones pendientes
example_tasks_ru: Продлить полис ОСАГО на следующий год
Проверить синхронизацию контактов между телефоном и облаком
Обновить прошивку домашнего роутера до последней версии

context_tasks.task: Swap out the reverse osmosis under-sink water filter cartridge
Review weekly habit tracker streaks on Sunday evening
Refill monthly blood pressure medication at the pharmacy
Rotate seasonal clothes in the bedroom closet

near_misses.task: Take the glass jars and cardboard boxes to the recycling bin
Send project status update email to the client
Update my resume with the new engineering role
Return the borrowed circular saw to Dave
Buy rechargeable AA batteries for the Xbox controllers
Call customer support to ask for a refund on the double charge

reasoning: The icon combines circular sync/refresh arrows with a central checkmark, clearly representing a completed sync, software update, backup verification, or subscription renewal. It fits many common tech, finance, and admin tasks, though in a to-do app its central checkmark can slightly overlap conceptually with task completion.
